description: Britain's largest Hillfort, middle - late iron age occupation features included 4-post structures and storage pits containing 'special' deposits, as well as a rectangular enclosure that is thought to served as a 'community meeting place' with 'religious associations'. The RSRB marks the site as a 'shrine', but its unclear if they have a specific feature in mind. Both features above belong to the pre-conquest phase.
